state.paragraph: **Redundant null-guard assignment** `# null-guard-noop` (`config`, `formatting`) — builder `parseProperties` guards of the shape `if (x != null) this.field = x;`: forcing the branch assigns null over an already-null field on a fresh single-use builder, and `create()` null-coalesces the default either way. Sites: `EpochServiceConfig$Parser`, `TxMonitorConfig$Parser`, `TableCacheConfig$Builder`, `HeliusConfig$Parser`, `ChainItemFormatter$Parser`.
